title: Private cluster readiness badges and action strip — prototype + review
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Operators and tenant owners need a low-friction surface in the Private/VPC console that shows per-cluster readiness for a planned upgrade and surface safe, reversible actions. Current cluster lists are noisy and require drilling into multiple pages to assess network, capacity, and egress readiness.

Goal: Design a compact, persistent ‘readiness badge + action strip’ that sits on cluster rows and the cluster detail header. The badge summarizes readiness (green/yellow/red) across network connectivity, capacity headroom, KV cache validity, and pending security prerequisites. The action strip provides one-click runbooks, preflight checks, canary enable toggles, and a quick rollback trigger. The prototype should work in both single-cluster and multi-cluster views and scale to 50+ clusters without visual overload.
acceptance_criteria:
- Compact badge with tooltip showing per-check breakdown is present on cluster list and cluster header.
- Action strip exposes: Run preflight checks, Start canary (with default 5% tenant sample), Schedule maintenance window, and Trigger safe-rollback.
- All actions surface confirmation modals with estimated impact and links to detailed runbooks.
- Designs include desktop and narrow-width tablet layouts and a11y color contrast tokens.
- Handoff-ready Figma frames and component specs exported to IDE tokens.
comments: 2025-02-12 Ava Martinez: Initial discovery — interviewed three platform engineers and two SREs. Key pain points: (1) ambiguous 'healthy' state in cluster list, (2) too many steps to run preflight, (3) no single surface for urgent rollback. Drafted scope and component list.

2025-02-18 Liam O'Connor: Wireframes uploaded to Figma (link above). Proposed microstates for badge: good / degraded (with primary failing check) / blocked. Action strip proposal added beneath cluster header in list and pinned to detail header.

2025-02-20 Maya Chen (PM): Reviewed flows. Please add explicit cost estimate for canary traffic and an override for reserved capacity pools. Also flagged KMS prerequisites for Private deployments; security review likely needed.

2025-02-24 Nathan Patel (Eng): Feasibility check — preflight runs available via existing lifecycle API but needs an endpoint for batch-checks across clusters. Suggested adding 'last-validated' timestamp to badge and showing cache TTL. Also noted we should expose tokenized links for audit logs.

2025-02-26 Design critique: Raised concerns about color-only signals. Decided to include an icon glyph + text label and accessible pattern for color-blind users. Confirmed hover/tap expands a compact checklist with pass/fail icons.

2025-02-28 Liam O'Connor: High-fidelity prototype created. Added animation for state transitions (idle -> checking -> result) and microcopy for each action. Pushed design specs to the shared tokens file (console-tokens.v2).

2025-03-01 Security review kickoff: Scheduled with Security team. Need to validate: (1) one-click rollback audit trail, (2) permission gating for canary start/rollback, (3) KMS access for private clusters. Added security review tag.

2025-03-01 UX review session notes: Feedback to reduce the size of the action strip on mobile and collapse secondary actions under 'More' menu. PM asked to add telemetry events: readiness_check.started, readiness_check.completed, canary.toggled, rollback.initiated.

2025-03-01 Next steps: Address Security checklist items, implement small engineering spike for batch preflight API (ENG-20398), iterate on microcopy for confirmation modals, and prepare PRD for release-train acceptance.
2025-03-01 Links: GH spike branch - https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/20398, Dashboard mock - https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/cluster/readiness-sample
